source_evidence.repetition_limitation: First TRAIN execution generated original results but its ZIP omitted the raw JSON due to an artifact-upload path bug. Exact source and parameters were unchanged for the second execution; only artifact paths were corrected. Two executions of the same TRAIN cohort are NOT independent replications, and neither may substitute for protected confirmation.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Low-degree parity inverse fit only on noisy public FIT samples, calibrated by task-local public CHECK; no source operator catalog.
Yggdrasil.scientific_result: NEGATIVE. No parity candidate passed the FIT strict FP0/sensitivity/control threshold, so candidate SCREEN and DEV were not executed. Source-only oracle ceiling is diagnostic, never learned.

Wingless.hypothesis: Learn one graph-conditioned choice of exactly one 12bit encoding from public edge/role density; retain one state/node.
Wingless.scientific_result: NEGATIVE. No conditional policy met strict FIT false-positive, paired and baseline-accepted long-chain preservation criteria. SCREEN ran original gamma-zero only; no model improvement claim or DEV admission.

next_gate: F124-AV: qualified research should move away from insufficient task-local public inverse demonstrations or directly test identifiability-limited causal representation and enforce positive preservation in one-state Wingless without using consumed screens to tune.
